title: Inventory reservation timeout under concurrent checkouts
description: During peak integration stress testing, POST /inventory/reserve-items from Order Service times out after 3000ms due to unindexed database row lock.
expectedResult: Stock reservation API returns HTTP 200 within 500ms SLA under 50 req/sec load.
actualResult: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout returned after 3200ms lock expiration.

title: Missing Idempotency-Key handling on payment charge retry
description: Retrying POST /payments/process-charge with the same idempotency key executes duplicate authorization charges instead of returning cached transaction token.
relatedIntegrationName: Order Management Service → Payment Gateway Service
expectedResult: Duplicate charge requests return HTTP 200 with original charge payload and Idempotency-Replay header.
actualResult: Duplicate charge created with new authorization ID resulting in double charge.

title: Backorder status patch throws HTTP 500 when item quantity is 0
description: PATCH /orders/backorder-status crashes with NullPointerException when an out-of-stock SKU has availableQuantity: 0 in payload body.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 OK with order status transitioned to 'BACKORDER_PENDING'.
actualResult: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with unhandled NullPointerException in OrderStateTransitionManager.

title: Auth token header casing sensitivity in User verification endpoint
description: User Service rejects tokens when header is sent as 'authorization' (lowercase) instead of 'Authorization' (titlecase).
expectedResult: Header lookup should be case-insensitive per RFC 7230 standards.
actualResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized returned when lowercase authorization header is provided.

title: SMS notification template rendering failure for international phone prefixes
description: POST /notifications/order-confirmation fails to dispatch SMS when phone number includes non-US country code (+91, +44).
expectedResult: Notification service handles E.164 formatted international mobile numbers.
actualResult: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with error 'Invalid phone number format'.

title: OAuth 2.0 handshake token expiry handshake loop
description: When merchant token expires, automatic refresh handshake enters cyclic redirect if client secret is refreshed during rotation.
expectedResult: Single token refresh execution with exponential backoff on retry.
actualResult: 10 consecutive refresh calls triggered in under 500ms causing temporary rate limit.
